subject: Re: Status: encoder integrated, feedback loop demo on track, schema debt
body:
Team,

Pilot-readiness review outcome (we squeezed it in 4/10 per Bao's calendar ask):

1. READY for the May pilot with the two normalized schemas. The 11.8% -> 9.6% MAPE improvement plus the minutes-scale feedback loop was the demo that landed - the partner rep literally asked when they could type in their own rules.
2. The free-text market-principles schema is formally deferred into the pilot phase, owned by Paloma with a design doc due 5/8. No fragile parser ships, agreed with Hyun's recommendation.
3. Pilot success criteria, agreed with the partner: MAPE parity or better vs their incumbent on 4 of 5 product lines, and at least one forecast correction round-tripped through the feedback loop per week.

Ondrej carries the encoder into the pilot per the staffing plan. Nice work all - this one reviewed itself.

Anders
